law_text: The driver of a vehicle shall not follow another vehicle more closely than is reasonable and prudent, having due regard for the speed of such vehicles and the traffic upon and the condition of the highway.

cases.rationale: Reference following interval: equal speeds, authored 25 m bumper gap, then a position-triggered lane change over the crest.
unresolved_judgment_calls: Whether the following distance was reasonable and prudent

channels.name: ego_speed_mps
channels.method: Native actor.get_velocity magnitude each tick
channels.reference_frame: road frame (s along lane direction, lane ids from native waypoint readback)
channels.uncertainty: engine velocity; no sensor noise model

channels.name: lead_speed_mps
channels.method: Native actor.get_velocity magnitude of the control (lead) vehicle each tick
channels.reference_frame: road frame (s along lane direction, lane ids from native waypoint readback)
channels.uncertainty: engine velocity

channels.name: bumper_gap_m
channels.method: Road-frame distance from lead rear to ego front while the lead is ahead in the ego lane; -1 when none
channels.reference_frame: road frame (s along lane direction, lane ids from native waypoint readback)
channels.uncertainty: nominal bounding-box length; straight road so s equals x

channels.name: ego_lane_id
channels.method: Native waypoint lane_id readback at ego location
channels.reference_frame: road frame (s along lane direction, lane ids from native waypoint readback)
channels.uncertainty: lane assignment by native map projection

context_inputs.name: surface_context
context_inputs.method: authored world setup plus native readback (wetness, friction, grade, crest, public-way declaration)

limitations: Reasonable and prudent following distance is a legal judgment and is not measured.
Public-way status is an authored declaration of a synthetic road.
Tire friction is an engine setting, not a measured real-world coefficient.

existing_evidence: review-context README lists eight accepted imported recordings for this cell/law (base, closer, faster_ego, slower_lead, lead_brakes, wet_surface, following_ends, queued_traffic); not re-derived here and not reused as proof of this package.
runtime_uncertainties: No CARLA/GPU in this clone: motion, lane-change completion, crest geometry, camera visibility and 45 s duration are unverified.
Wheel friction and weather are engine settings, not measured real-world values.
Camera poses are re-set before each tick and may trail by one tick.
Demo-train comparison preflight not performed: no accepted demo-train data is present in this clone.
